jobDetails.title: Consumer Facing Mobile Apps Leads/Managers needed
jobDetails.description:
Mobile Apps Engineering Lead / Architects / Manager

Our client is start up in Mumbai, which is funded by a European VC.

They are developing a consumer facing App, which could be marketed globally.

What you are :

BE CS from IITs or Equivalent

10-25 years hands on experience in Consumer facing Apps development

Worked in TV/Video/Ecommerce/Retail etc

Worked in FAMG Cos or top 20 ecommerce Companies in India

Willing to work in hands on manner and show good team work
